name: hdie_svg_fg2-svg_fg2-COMMIT
purpose: HBM d4g SM service group ot_hbm_svc_sm_group_id #(LBANKS 4, FIXED_GO 1) x16 (svg_SW0..7, svg_NW0..7). Two families (stream 833.333 / hbm 1024) via reviewed ot_hbm_svc_async_fifo; 15 SRAMs + 9 dual-clock FIFO SRAMs (8 response 8x285, 1 descriptor 4x97; L2H-IDXSCORE/SVG fg2: checklist item 5); landing SRAM write port stream-registered (WREG=1).
